description: Land Title Settlement Department - Siyambalanduwa, Siyambalanduwa D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720005
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, extents, and ownership details) in the Siyambalanduwa area. The content focuses on land adjudication, title determinations, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
